questions.stem:
SCIENCE PASSAGE 3: Layered Thermal Insulation
A team wrapped identical warm-water containers with 0, 1, 2, or 3 felt layers. Experiment 1 measured water temperature after 30 minutes in still air. Experiment 2 repeated the test with a fan producing constant airflow. Every container began at 70°C and contained the same water volume.

Which conclusion is best supported by the combined experiments?
F) The experiment proves the pattern will remain unchanged under every possible condition.
G) The independent variable had no relationship to any measured outcome.
H) Additional felt layers reduced cooling, while airflow increased cooling for every tested layer count.
J) The data justify replacing all observations with a single average.

options.A: The experiment proves the pattern will remain unchanged under every possible condition.
options.B: The independent variable had no relationship to any measured outcome.
options.C: Additional felt layers reduced cooling, while airflow increased cooling for every tested layer count.
options.D: The data justify replacing all observations with a single average.

questions.explanation: The conclusion reflects the measured results and remains within the experimental scope.

questions.stem:
SCIENCE MATERIAL SET 4
Students tested how water temperature affected the time required for a tablet to dissolve. They used identical tablets, 103 mL of water in each cup, and stirred each cup at the same rate.

TABLE 1
Temperature (°C) | Dissolving time (s)
10 | 32
20 | 24
30 | 19
40 | 15

Trial 2 repeated the procedure with twice the water volume. Researcher 1 claims that higher temperature increases particle motion and therefore decreases dissolving time. Researcher 2 agrees that temperature matters but claims that stirring rate is the dominant factor whenever stirring is not controlled.

Which result most strongly supports Researcher 1?
A) Dissolving time is lower at 40°C than at 10°C.
B) The cups have equal volumes.
C) The tablet names are identical.
D) The experiment uses a stopwatch.

options.A: Dissolving time is lower at 40°C than at 10°C.
options.C: The tablet names are identical.

questions.explanation: The keyed response follows the material and directly targets 选择支持或削弱主张的证据.
